title: Real prices in 6 lines of Python
code:
import requests

url = "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/AAPL.US"
params = {"api_token": "YOUR_KEY", "fmt": "json", "from": "2026-01-01"}
prices = requests.get(url, params=params).json()
print(prices[-1]["close"])
caption: Give your AI this instead of asking it to remember a price.
